name: AgentDojo
summary: ETH Zurich benchmark environment for prompt-injection attacks and defenses on tool-using LLM agents, with suites like workspace, banking, travel and slack.
description: Runs agents on realistic user tasks while injected tool outputs try to hijack them, measuring both utility and attack success for combinations of models, attacks and defenses (e.g. a tool filter or prompt-injection detector). `pip install agentdojo`; run with `python -m agentdojo.scripts.benchmark`. Paper: [arXiv:2406.13352](https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.13352) (NeurIPS 2024 Datasets & Benchmarks); results are published on the docs site. The README notes the package API is still under development.
